fault_scenarios.title: job create save failure leaves a memory or queue ghost
fault_scenarios.reproduction_condition: Inject pre-replace, post-replace, unreadable-primary, and pending-guard failures into the physical JSON writer, then compare the typed commit outcome, same-process memory and queue, authoritative primary, pending marker, restart load block, worker dispatch, and API response.
current_trace: src/DesktopNode.Runtime/DesktopNodeJobRuntime.cs CreateUnsafe builds candidate jobs and queue, writes that candidate, and only then replaces the live references

src/DesktopNode.Runtime/JsonFileDesktopNodeJobStore.cs flushes a unique same-directory temp and pending-commit identity before replace, reconciles candidate or previous primary, and retains an unresolved guard for restart blocking

src/DesktopNode.Runtime/DesktopNodeJobRuntimeContracts.cs carries committed, not committed, and indeterminate outcomes while src/DesktopNode.Api/DesktopNodeApiRequestProcessor.cs maps failed create commits to redacted HTTP 503 and blocks later job routes
existing_evidence: DesktopNode.Runtime.Tests.JobRuntimeDurabilityTests.CreateSaveFailureDoesNotPublishMemoryOrQueueGhost proves attempted candidate write adds no ghost and preserves empty or previously acknowledged same-process, disk, and restart state

DesktopNode.Runtime.Tests.JsonFileDesktopNodeJobStoreTests covers unique temp and flush order, not-committed preservation, committed exact-primary reconciliation, unresolved marker restart blocking, orphan-temp non-promotion, and the 0.42.65-compatible v1/v2 shape contract; an actual frozen binary reader remains separate

DesktopNode.Api.Tests.ApiJobStoreFailureCharacterizationTests.CreateSaveFailureDoesNotReturn202OrInvokeNativeMutation proves HTTP 503 structured redaction, job list zero, worker false, and native invoke zero

DesktopNode.Api.Tests.ApiJobStoreFailureCharacterizationTests.IndeterminateCreateCommitReturns503AndBlocksJobRoutesAndWorker proves redacted indeterminate diagnostics, later job-route block, worker false, and native invoke zero
fault_scenarios.expected_safe_result: Under the product's single SCM runtime owner, only a committed physical outcome may publish memory, queue, or HTTP success. Not-committed preserves the previous primary; indeterminate retains a startup-readable guard and blocks same-process plus restart dispatch until candidate or previous SHA and length reconcile. No stale temp or backup is promoted. Lifetime path leasing or compare-and-swap remains required before multiple runtime owners can share one path safely.

red.fails_on_baseline_because: CreateJob mutates jobs and queue before SaveJobStore throws.

green.implementation_boundary: stage next state, require a typed committed result, and publish memory and HTTP success only after unique-temp and pending-guard flush plus exact-primary reconciliation

temporary_characterization.removal_condition: Completed: the Runtime unsafe characterization was replaced 1:1 after commit-before-publish, physical outcome reconciliation, same-process and restart dispatch blocking, and retained API integration companions passed.

fault_scenarios.title: start cancel or complete save failure diverges memory and disk meaning
fault_scenarios.reproduction_condition: Use DesktopNodeJobRuntime with a recording store to inject a save failure separately at start, queued cancel, running cancel, and terminal completion, then compare memory, durable file, restart state, and provider signal; retain API tests for native dispatch and linked cancellation integration.
current_trace: src/DesktopNode.Runtime/DesktopNodeJobRuntime.cs calculates start, cancel, and complete candidate state and publishes it only after a committed store result
running cancel commits and publishes PCV_JOB_CANCEL_REQUESTED before signaling the provider outside stateSync; a repeated request does not save or signal again
terminal persistence failure keeps the confirmed running live state, blocks later mutation and dispatch, and never replays the uncertain provider side effect
existing_evidence: DesktopNode.Runtime.Tests.JobRuntimeDurabilityTests.StartSaveFailureKeepsRecoverableMeaning and TransitionSaveFailureKeepsRecoverableMeaning compare live, durable, restart, queue, and provider traces
DesktopNode.Runtime.Tests.JobRuntimeDurabilityTests.RunningCancelPersistsRequestBeforeProviderSignalOutsideStateLock proves durable commit, live publish, then out-of-lock provider signal

DesktopNode.Api.Tests.ApiHardeningRequestProcessorTests.BackgroundWorkerPreservesQueuedJobWhenStartSaveFailsAndReturnsStructuredError and DesktopNode.Api.Tests.ApiJobStoreFailureCharacterizationTests.RunningCancelPersistsBeforeSignalAndUsesLinkedToken retain native-dispatch and linked-token integration coverage
fault_scenarios.expected_safe_result: Every transition has one durable commit protocol; a save failure leaves an explicit recoverable disk, memory, restart, and provider-signal meaning and never silently replays an uncertain side effect.

red.fails_on_baseline_because: start, cancel, and complete mutate memory before the corresponding durable save and running cancel signals the provider before save.

green.implementation_boundary: single-writer transition commit with explicit recovery record and cancellation signal outside the state lock

temporary_characterization.removal_condition: Completed: unsafe Runtime characterizations were removed after exact safe invariants added durable file, restart, provider-order, and no-replay assertions; API companions remain.

fault_scenarios.title: GET timeout permits late work to commit or overlap the next request
fault_scenarios.reproduction_condition: Use a read adapter that ignores cancellation, force the first GET to return 504, start a second GET before releasing the first adapter, and record maximum concurrency, late commits, and tracked task completion.
current_trace: src/DesktopNode.Api/DesktopNodeApiRequestProcessor.cs:194-226 returns 504 after cancel without awaiting the route task
src/DesktopNode.Api/DesktopNodeApiRequestProcessor.cs:171-191 releases the outer serialization lock when the timed-out Handle returns
existing_evidence: DesktopNode.Api.Tests.ApiRuntimePolicyRequestProcessorTests.ProcessorSerializesConcurrentHandleCalls verifies serialization only when no request times out
fault_scenarios.expected_safe_result: A timed-out request cannot commit application state or overlap the next request under the serialized policy, and its task completion or fault remains supervised.

red.fails_on_baseline_because: the timed-out Task.Run continues after the Handle lock is released

green.implementation_boundary: end-to-end async lifetime, explicit serialization gate, post-timeout commit guard, and tracked child completion

temporary_characterization.removal_condition: Remove after sync-over-async Task.Run plus Wait is gone and the replacement test proves zero late commit and serialized overlap.

fault_scenarios.title: malformed or non-object job store crashes startup without a structured state
fault_scenarios.reproduction_condition: Construct DesktopNodeJobRuntime with malformed JSON, invalid UTF-8, each valid non-object root, and invalid job/queue semantics; then observe the typed blocked state, no rewrite, and zero dispatch.
current_trace: src/DesktopNode.Runtime/DesktopNodeJobStoreSnapshotValidator.cs classifies Valid, UnsupportedFuture, and Corrupt before Runtime projects any state
src/DesktopNode.Runtime/DesktopNodeJobRuntime.cs publishes no jobs or queue for corrupt input and returns redacted PCV_JOB_STORE_CORRUPT without quarantine or rewrite
existing_evidence: DesktopNode.Runtime.Tests.DesktopNodeJobRuntimeTests.MalformedOrNonObjectRootStartsInStructuredBlockedState covers malformed plus six non-object roots without rewrite or dispatch
DesktopNode.Runtime.Tests.JsonJobStoreSemanticIntegrityTests covers typed root/schema/job/queue/state integrity classification for v1/v2 and unsupported future input
DesktopNode.Api.Tests.ApiRuntimePolicyRequestProcessorTests.JobStoreUnsupportedFutureVersionReturnsBlockedDiagnosticsWithoutQuarantine remains a valid-object future-schema integration companion
fault_scenarios.expected_safe_result: Startup remains alive with a structured blocked or quarantined result, no mutation or silent overwrite occurs, and operator recovery guidance is redacted and explicit.

red.fails_on_baseline_because: valid non-object roots reach JsonElement.TryGetProperty and can throw InvalidOperationException from construction

green.implementation_boundary: typed load result with root-kind and semantic validation before reading properties

temporary_characterization.removal_condition: Completed: malformed plus all six non-object roots now produce a structured no-mutation result and the old unstructured theory is absent.

fault_scenarios.title: shutdown does not track HTTP request and noVNC bridge child tasks
fault_scenarios.reproduction_condition: Open a blocked HTTP body read and a bidirectional noVNC bridge, stop or dispose the host, then observe admission close, both copy directions, task registry, socket handles, and the drain deadline.
current_trace: src/DesktopNode.Host/DesktopNodeHostApplication.cs:54-60 stores only listener and worker loop tasks
src/DesktopNode.Host/DesktopNodeHostApplication.cs:154-173 starts accepted requests as untracked fire-and-forget tasks
src/DesktopNode.Host/DesktopNodeHostApplication.cs:399-415 awaits only Task.WhenAny for noVNC and does not cancel or await the peer direction
existing_evidence: DesktopNode.Host.Tests.DesktopNodeHostApplicationTests.NoVncBridgeProxiesWebSocketFramesToLoopbackTcpTarget covers frame proxy happy path only
fault_scenarios.expected_safe_result: Shutdown closes admission, tracks and drains every HTTP and noVNC task, cancels and observes both bridge directions, and finishes with zero tracked tasks and socket leaks within policy.

red.fails_on_baseline_because: accepted request tasks are discarded and noVNC observes only the first copy task to finish

green.implementation_boundary: bounded admission and one application-lifetime request or noVNC task registry with ordered cancellation and drain

temporary_characterization.removal_condition: Do not remove the frame parity test; close only the shutdown gap after the two new drain tests pass.

fault_scenarios.title: listener or worker fault is not visible to Windows Service health
fault_scenarios.reproduction_condition: Inject an unexpected listener accept-loop failure and a non-cancellation worker failure, then observe the Windows Service ExecuteTask, current health, event reason, and final running state.
current_trace: src/DesktopNode.Host/DesktopNodeHostApplication.cs:154-170 turns every HttpListenerException into a normal listener-loop return
src/DesktopNode.Api/DesktopNodeApiRequestProcessor.cs:2190-2238 catches unexpected worker exceptions and continues the outer idle loop
src/DesktopNode.Host/DesktopNodeWindowsService.cs:9-20 waits an infinite delay instead of child task completion
existing_evidence: DesktopNode.Host.Tests.DesktopNodeHostApplicationTests.HostStartsBackgroundWorkerForQueuedJobs covers only normal startup and processing
fault_scenarios.expected_safe_result: Unexpected listener or worker completion fails service health within a bounded time, never leaves Running-but-dead, records a redacted structured reason, and drains remaining work.

red.fails_on_baseline_because: the service waits an unrelated infinite delay and neither listener nor worker fault is supervised as terminal health

green.implementation_boundary: one application lifetime supervisor awaits listener and worker completion and propagates unexpected exit to Windows Service health

temporary_characterization.removal_condition: Close after both injected fault tests and installed current-card non-running or unhealthy evidence pass.
